item.title: Hakkoda-maru Memorial Ship: Aomori's Ferry Museum — Guide
item.description: Moored in Aomori harbor beside the station, the Hakkoda-maru is a preserved Seikan railway ferry, now a floating museum. Before the Seikan Tunnel opened, these ships carried trains and passengers across the strait to Hokkaido — you can explore the bridge, engine room and nostalgic Showa-era passenger decks. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Aomori City (Aomori harbor) Hours ~9:00–19:00 (seasonal; closed some days) Admission Around ¥510 Time needed About 1 hour Best time Year-round What to See The preserved Seikan railway ferry on the water.

item.title: Osaka Honeymoon Guide: Romantic Dining, Harbor Views & Intimate Experiences
item.description: Osaka’s romance is different from Kyoto’s — where Kyoto offers the contemplative intimacy of temple lanterns and ryokan gardens, Osaka offers something more unexpected: the shared pleasure of extraordinary food, the warmth of a genuinely friendly city, and moments of unexpected beauty (the rose garden on Nakanoshima island, the floating garden observatory at night, the lit barges on the Okawa River at cherry blossom season) that feel more discovered than staged.
